title: 2026 UK ETS revised auction calendar and maritime uplift QA

sources.title: Taking part in the UK Emissions Trading Scheme markets
Taking part in the UK ETS markets - publication updates

facts.source_fact: ICE published a revised 2026 auction calendar on 1 July 2026.
The revision accounts for inclusion of maritime emissions in the UK ETS.
The 2026 auction volume was increased by 983,000 allowances.
Just under 53 million allowances are scheduled to be auctioned across 25 auctions in 2026.
The 2026 auction sequence began on 14 January 2026.
The additional maritime-related volume is spread across remaining 2026 auctions.
The additional volume begins being applied from the 12 August 2026 auction.
UKA auctions continue to take place fortnightly.
ICE Futures Europe is the current UK ETS auction platform provider.
The calendar revision is an operational 2026 update, not a parcel-level emissions measurement.
